meta.name: RouteFrom Temporal Observatory
meta.description: Exploratory, unapproved design draft for a quiet personal spatiotemporal observatory. It is not a finalized visual style, page architecture, or API contract.

primary.role: Observed trajectory, active time, focus and primary action

secondary.role: Confirmed stays, places and warm temporal anchors

accent.role: Secondary time slices, information and comparison state

neutral.usage: Near-black map and chrome, mineral-gray structure, high-value text reserved for selected facts

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast selected facts over subtle layered chrome; semantic color never carries meaning without shape or label

font_families.heading: IBM Plex Sans Condensed, Source Han Sans SC, Microsoft YaHei UI, sans-serif
font_families.body: IBM Plex Sans, Source Han Sans SC, Microsoft YaHei UI, sans-serif
font_families.mono: IBM Plex Mono, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: A field-instrument pairing: condensed headings conserve horizontal space, calm humanist body copy explains uncertainty, monospace is limited to coordinates, instants and algorithm evidence

spacing.section_rhythm: 8px inside controls, 16px inside groups, 24px between semantic regions; map retains the largest uninterrupted negative space

layout.grid_system: Resizable instrument dock around a dominant map field
layout.columns: 48px tool rail + 288px layer/time dock + fluid map + 320px contextual inspector
layout.gutter: 1px structural dividers, 12px floating-map offsets, 16px panel padding

breakpoints.wide: 1440px and above: both side docks visible
breakpoints.desktop: 1180px–1439px: inspector becomes an overlay drawer with persistent reopen affordance
breakpoints.compact: 960px–1179px: left dock collapses to rail-triggered overlay; timeline remains resizable
breakpoints.mobile_future: below 960px: map-first route with bottom sheets; not a squeezed desktop grid

layout.alignment_tendency: Strict instrument grid with controlled asymmetry in floating map controls and inspector cards

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px mineral borders define interactive surfaces; structural docks use hairline dividers; selected ranges use double cues
shape.divider_style: 1px rgba(220,228,224,0.08), brighter only at active resize boundaries

elevation.shadow_style: Low, wide and dark with restrained mineral glow for focus
elevation.depth_cues: Layered near-black values, blur on floating controls, overlap above the map and selective mint edge light

iconography.style: Rounded geometric outline with state expressed by enclosure and fill
iconography.preferred_set: Lucide for chrome; custom SVG glyphs only for temporal strata and confidence states

motion.entrance_pattern: Docks settle 8px into place while the map is already interactive; no theatrical splash screen
motion.exit_pattern: Selected details compress toward their map or timeline anchor before fading
motion.philosophy: Functional continuity: movement explains spatial and temporal causality, never decorates high-frequency playback

components.button_style: Quiet ghost or tonal buttons, 32–36px high, one-pixel edge, explicit focus ring, active state uses a shallow mineral fill rather than a luminous CTA block
components.input_style: Dark inset fields with persistent labels, mono treatment for time values, visible keyboard focus and no placeholder-only meaning
components.card_style: Cards are reserved for semantic objects and evidence; most navigation remains borderless lists to avoid dashboard-card repetition
components.navigation_pattern: Tool rail changes the left dock; command palette provides cross-domain navigation; inspector is selection-driven rather than a permanent settings column
components.modal_style: Anchored popovers for local edits, centered command palette for global actions, bottom temporal composer for complex multi-range editing
components.list_style: Compact rows with a semantic rail, primary label, evidence line and trailing state; selection changes background and left rail together
components.component_notes: Temporal range chips have grab handles and set-operation affordances. Confidence is shown by label plus a calibrated meter, not vague colored badges. Unknown periods are cut-outs; inferred paths are dashed; excluded points use crossed glyphs. Resize handles are keyboard operable. No shadcn visual defaults.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A nocturnal field observatory reading layers of personal time like a geological core sample
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary scientific instruments with restrained cartographic editorialism

visual_language.complexity: Rich data semantics inside a visually restrained shell
visual_language.ornamentation: Subtle cartographic glow and temporal texture only where they encode state
visual_language.whitespace_usage: The map is breathing room; panels are dense but rhythmically grouped
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Map dominates; timeline is the signature analytical surface; side docks recede until an entity is selected
visual_language.focal_strategy: A shared selected entity and time cursor create one cross-surface focus
visual_language.contrast_level: Moderate global contrast with high local contrast for selected facts
visual_language.texture_usage: Very faint map grain and scanline-free temporal density, never decorative noise over text

composition.hierarchy_method: Spatial scale, semantic rails, type compression and selective color
composition.balance_type: Asymmetric instrument layout balanced by a dominant central map
composition.flow_direction: Dataset and time intent from left to map, evidence from map/time to the right inspector
composition.grouping_strategy: Group by user task and epistemic state, not by database table
composition.negative_space_role: Preserves geographic immersion and makes sparse personal moments feel intentional

imagery.photo_treatment: No stock photography; optional place memories use low-saturation edge-to-edge crops with metadata overlays
imagery.illustration_style: No generic illustrations; use cartographic contours, calibrated diagrams and trajectory glyphs
imagery.graphic_elements: Temporal strata, covariance halos, route strokes, uncertainty cut-outs and subtle contour rings
imagery.pattern_usage: Dashed rhythm exclusively signals inference; sparse diagonal hatch signals excluded or unavailable data
imagery.image_shape: Map-native geometry and restrained 10–14px clipped media when personal imagery exists

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate local preview, then quiet confirmation when a normalized time selection or manual correction is committed
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: One level of tonal lift plus cross-highlight on map and timeline; no scale bounce
interaction_feel.loading_style: Progressive spatial detail with stable skeleton geometry and explicit processing stage labels
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Low-to-moderate; concentrated on time editing, cross-highlighting, resizing and correction confidence

brand_voice_in_ui.formality: Conversational professional Chinese with precise time and uncertainty terms
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Direct verbs such as 创建切片、聚焦、保存修正、发布结果
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain what data is absent and offer the next meaningful action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: State what failed, which processing stage was affected and what can be retried; never apologize vaguely

overview.fallback_strategy: Keep MapLibre and static vector/Canvas marks, reduce glow and animation, disable animated density and use simplified trajectories when reduced motion or low hardware concurrency is detected
overview.primary_technology: MapLibre GL plus deck.gl WebGL for the map, Canvas 2D/WebGL for the temporal strata, Motion for dock transitions

background_effects.description: A nearly imperceptible mineral grain confined to empty map and floating chrome, never over labels

particle_systems.description: Particles would confuse data points and are intentionally absent

3d_elements.description: No decorative 3D scene; map pitch alone provides geographic depth

shader_effects.description: Custom shaders are deferred until a data-semantic need exists

scroll_morphing.description: Application workspace uses local panels, not page scroll storytelling

text_effects.description: Typography remains stable during analysis and playback

cursor_effects.description: Native cursor semantics are retained for dense analytical work

image_effects.description: Personal place imagery, when present, uses restrained static treatment

params.shadow_type: wide dark ambient with optional 1px mint focus glow

canvas_drawings.description: The temporal strata render observed movement, stays, unknown gaps, inferred connections and multi-range handles as one zoomable field
canvas_drawings.technology: Canvas 2D initially, deck.gl/WebGL when event density requires

params.draw_method: DPR-aware batched paths and rectangles with semantic hit-test index
params.animation_loop: requestAnimationFrame only during playback, drag or transition
params.responsiveness: ResizeObserver and stable virtual time scale
params.interaction: brush, resize, split, subtract, hover cross-highlight and keyboard nudge

svg_animations.description: Only newly selected or corrected route fragments receive a brief path confirmation draw

params.filter_effects: subtle mint glow, disabled under reduced motion

visual_effects.composite_notes: The signature temporal strata is both an analytical control and a visual identity. The map remains visually quiet so temporal selections and epistemic states read clearly. GPU capacity is spent on real trajectory density, filtering and playback rather than decorative effects. All enabled effects degrade to static CSS/Canvas without losing observed-versus-inferred semantics.
